# Architecture: Crypto Hunt

Decisions referenced as D-xxx live in [PROJECT_DECISIONS.md](PROJECT_DECISIONS.md). Same shape as AI Musical Chair.

## Major components

```
                         ┌──────────────────────────── Vercel (Next.js 15) ─────────────────────────────┐
 Player phone ──HTTPS──▶ │ /play      join, team status, scanner + key, question, clue, map, leaderboard│
 Admin laptop ──HTTPS──▶ │ /admin     setup (teams, locations, map, generator, print), live, controls   │
 Projector tab ─HTTPS──▶ │ /screen    read-only leaderboard, map with ships, splashes, 3D chest finale  │
                         │ /q/[token] "opened in a normal camera" landing (no side effects)             │
                         └───────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                         │ supabase-js (RPC, Auth, Realtime)
                         ┌───────────────▼──────────────── Supabase cloud ─────────────────┐
                         │ Auth (players: name+team code via Edge Function; admin: name+code)│
                         │ Edge Function: player-join                                        │
                         │ Postgres: tables + RLS + security-definer RPCs (the game engine)  │
                         │ Storage: venue map image                                          │
                         │ Realtime: public_state, team_state, events, alerts                │
                         └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| Component | Responsibility | Lives in |
|---|---|---|
| Game engine (SQL) | Join, scan resolution, answers, check-ins, penalties, round close, elimination, podium (D-002) | `supabase/migrations/*` |
| Player join (Edge Function) | Validates team code, creates a pre-confirmed account, holds the only use of the service key (D-005) | `supabase/functions/player-join` |
| Generator (TS, pure) | Builds the pyramid plan (rounds, links, paths, pranks, question picks) from teams + locations | `src/lib/generator.ts` |
| Engine model (TS) | Pure mirror of the rules for UI enablement and unit tests | `src/lib/engine.ts` |
| Data access | Typed RPC wrappers and realtime hooks | `src/lib/supabase/*`, `src/hooks/*` |
| Player app | Mobile flow, scanner, map, anti-cheat | `src/app/play/**`, `src/components/player/**` |
| Admin console | Setup, live dashboard, controls, overrides | `src/app/admin/**`, `src/components/admin/**` |
| Projector | Leaderboard, map, 3D finale | `src/app/screen/**`, `src/components/three/**` |
| Map | Parchment rendering, pins, fog reveal | `src/components/map/**` |
| 3D assets | Realistic Blender GLBs (chest, compass, scroll, lantern) | `public/models/*` |

## Boundaries

- **Clients never write game tables directly.** Players only call player RPCs. Admins call admin RPCs plus CRUD on `locations` and `questions` (admin RLS).
- **Generator output is untrusted input to SQL.** The admin browser builds the plan; `apply_game_plan(plan)` re-validates every invariant and creates all tokens and keys server-side. No secret is ever generated in the browser.
- **The screen is read-only** (`public_state` only).
- **The TS engine never decides anything.** SQL is the authority; both are tested on the same rule cases.

## Data flow

1. A player action calls an RPC: validate, write, update `team_state` and `public_state`, append `events` — all in one transaction.
2. Realtime pushes: `public_state` to everyone; the team's own `team_state` row to its members; `events` and `alerts` to the admin.
3. Clients re-render from pushed state. On reconnect they refetch `my_status()`.
4. All times come from the database clock (`now()`), never from the client.

## Trust boundaries

| Boundary | Untrusted input | Control |
|---|---|---|
| Phone → Edge Function | Name, team code | Validation, rate limit, team capacity check in one transaction |
| Phone → Supabase | QR tokens, keys, answers, hint requests, focus events | RPC validation, `auth.uid()` ownership, game/round/phase guards, row locks, RLS, rate limits |
| Admin browser → Supabase | Game plan, admin actions, locations, questions | `is_admin()` in every admin RPC and policy; plan re-validated in SQL |
| Anyone → `/q/[token]` | Token in URL | No side effects; the token is stripped from history and must be scanned inside `/play` |

## Integrations

- Supabase (Auth, Postgres, Realtime, Storage, Edge Functions). Vercel hosting.
- Blender (via MCP) at build time only, producing GLB files. No runtime third parties.

## Infrastructure

- Supabase prod project + separate test project (bot simulation and integration tests; D-022).
- Vercel project; env vars per environment.

## Failure modes

| Failure | Effect | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| A phone loses connection | Player can't act | Actions are idempotent; reconnect resyncs from `my_status()` |
| A phone dies | Team stuck at 3/4 | Member rejoins on another phone (session moves) or admin marks them inactive |
| QR damaged/stolen | Team can't check in | Admin re-points the team to a spare, or force-completes with a reason |
| Realtime drops | Admin feed stale | "Reconnecting…" badge; refetch on reconnect |
| Admin laptop closes | No control | Game state lives in the DB; log in again anywhere |
| Wrong elimination dispute | — | Audit log + event timeline with server timestamps |
